sections.title: Access
sections.intro_text: Access: this section asks about access to the park/space and about the surrounding area. Do your best to look around the space and its entrances to answer the questions. If asked to rate the condition of a feature consider whether it is poor (Ex: poorly maintained, unsafe, broken and/or dirty), acceptable (Ex: clean, in good shape, well maintained and/or relatively safe) or great (Ex: in really good shape, really well maintained, feels very safe)
sections.comment_prompt: Are there any comments you want to add about the Access of this space? (optional)

preamble: The YEE instrument is completed through a nine-step auditor flow: visit context, importance weighting, six domain sections, and final comments.
Section question wording comes from the survey definition itself, while visit details and importance-weighting prompts are part of the broader YEE audit workflow used in the web app.
Each saved instrument version is a complete snapshot. When a manager or auditor opens the YEE survey, the currently active version is the one the app uses.

pre_audit_questions.title: Auditor ID
pre_audit_questions.description: Automatically populated from the auditor profile at the start of the audit.

pre_audit_questions.title: Date of the audit
pre_audit_questions.description: Recorded when the auditor begins the audit and editable in the visit details step.

pre_audit_questions.title: Visit frequency
pre_audit_questions.prompt: How often have you been to / visited this space in the last 6 months?
pre_audit_questions.description: Single-select visit context question shown before the scored YEE sections begin.

options.label: I have never been here before
Every day or Almost every day
Only a few times (less than once a month)
I have not been here in the last 6 months

pre_audit_questions.title: Public access
pre_audit_questions.prompt: Is this place open to the public (or can only certain people use it)?
pre_audit_questions.description: Single-select visit context question shown before the scored YEE sections begin.

pre_audit_questions.title: Open all hours
pre_audit_questions.prompt: Is this place open all hours? (Ex: if it doesn't get closed or locked at certain times, like after 11pm)
pre_audit_questions.description: Single-select visit context question shown before the scored YEE sections begin.

pre_audit_questions.title: Season
pre_audit_questions.description: Single-select context question used in raw data and reporting.

pre_audit_questions.title: Weather
pre_audit_questions.prompt: What is the weather like today?
pre_audit_questions.description: Multi-select visit context question shown before the scored YEE sections begin.

pre_audit_questions.title: Importance weighting
pre_audit_questions.prompt: Please start by telling us how important each of the following issues are to you.
pre_audit_questions.description: Auditors assign a weight to each YEE domain before answering the section questions. These weights drive the youth-weighted score outputs in reports.

scale_guidance.title: Provision
scale_guidance.prompt: To what degree is this feature/environmental characteristic present or considered?
scale_guidance.description: Provision refers to the presence or quantity of an environmental feature or characteristic.

scale_guidance.title: Variety
scale_guidance.prompt: To what extent is there variety in the provision of this feature/environmental characteristic?
scale_guidance.description: Variety evaluates whether the provided feature offers variety in type, form, or opportunity rather than all options being the same.

scale_guidance.title: Challenge Opportunities
scale_guidance.prompt: To what extent does this feature/environmental characteristic provide different levels of challenge?
scale_guidance.description: Challenge opportunities assess whether the feature provides opportunities with different levels of difficulty.

scale_guidance.title: Sociability Support
scale_guidance.prompt: Can more than one child or person use this feature/environmental characteristic together?
scale_guidance.description: Sociability support assesses whether the feature can be used by more than one person at once, individually, in small groups, or in larger groups.

legal_documents.title: Service agreement
legal_documents.content: This YEE account may be used by invited managers and auditors to manage projects, places, audits, reports, and related field workflows. Managers control project and auditor access within their own organization, while platform admins have cross-organization reporting access. Auditors may complete only the audits assigned to them and may not reconfigure organization, project, place, or instrument settings.

legal_documents.title: Privacy guidance
legal_documents.content: Auditor personal details should remain visible only to managers inside the same organization. Platform administrators may view manager details and aggregate audit records, but auditor names and email addresses should remain restricted in admin-facing experiences.

weighting.title: Youth weighting
weighting.description: Tell us how important each of the following issues are to you, especially about the play/recreation and green spaces in your community.

domains.label: Access
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that you can easily and safely get to these spaces?

domains.label: Activity Spaces
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that these places have the spaces and/or equipment that allow you to do the activities you like (Ex: have spaces for sports/games, for hanging out with friends, for spending quiet time on your own, etc)?

domains.label: Amenities
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that these places have amenities that make the space more comfortable and suitable (like bathrooms, WiFi, garbage bins, places to buy food/drinks, seating for groups, shade, etc)?

domains.label: Experience of the Space
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that these places feel pleasant and safe to be in (Ex: feel peaceful, have lots of nature or nice views, feel safe and comfortable, where you will not be bothered or feel out of place, etc)?

domains.label: Aesthetics & Care
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that these places look nice and well cared for (Ex: have lots of greenery, have gardens or art to look at, are free from litter and graffiti, look like someone is taking good care of it, etc)?

domains.label: Use & Usability
domains.prompt: How important is it to you that these places are suitable for many activities for youth and/or the community (Ex: allow for lots of different types of activities, have lights that allow for night use, are good for youth programming or dog walking, etc)?

condition_prompt: If yes, please rate the condition that this feature or area is in.
